This repository is MIAW BASE, a reusable static browser boardgame starter. Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `docs/GAME_CONTRACT.md` before implementation. Keep `/core` generic and stable. Put game-specific mechanics under `/games`. Keep `app.js` as thin bootstrap code. Preserve direct `index.html` launch unless the user explicitly requests a build system. Reuse existing responsive UI, theme, sound, toast, storage, and turn utilities instead of duplicating them. Escape user-provided strings inserted into HTML. After changes, syntax-check all JavaScript and validate the complete game flow including reset and rematch.
